title: Marked split flat algebraic-space deformations and geometric operations
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $X$ an algebraic space over $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For every $K$-vector space $M$, use the actual bases $Y_M=\operatorname{Spec}(K\oplus M)$, reduction $j_M:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Y_M$, trivial product $X_M=X\times_K Y_M$, its projections and special-fibre inclusion, and its contravariant maps for linear coefficient maps from [def-sfb-space-marked-split-module-deformations]. Give $M$ its canonical central right $K$-action, equal to its left action. Use the structure morphism and coefficient conventions of [def-sfb-space-split-coefficient]. A marked flat deformation is an algebraic space $D$ over $Y_M$, flat on etale charts [def-sfb-space-morphism-properties], with $i:X\to D$ making the square over $j_M$ cartesian. Two such objects are related if an isomorphism between their spaces commutes with both base projections and markings; define $\operatorname{Def}_X(M)$ by the quotient by this relation and its class map. Triviality means a marked isomorphism to $X_M$. For $h:M\to N$, define base change by a cartesian square over the actual ring map $(a,m)\mapsto(a,h(m))$, compatible with the markings. A gluing of $D,E$ is a marked flat family over $Y_{M\times M}$ together with inclusions from $D,E$ giving a pushout square along their common $X$, whose base maps are induced by the two coordinate projections. Its marking is the common composite from $X$. Define $\operatorname{Aut}^0_X(M)$ as the automorphisms of the actual trivial family $X_M$ over $Y_M$ fixing its special fibre. An automorphism over $Y_N$ is the pullback of one over $Y_M$ when they intertwine the canonical product map $X_N\to X_M$ induced by $h$. These are definitions and operation relations, without any assertion of existence, classification or vector-space laws.
